name: AetherBuilder
changelog: New: Registration Form Image Options now prioritize image sizing — supports Fit / Natural (Max Image Priority), Banner (3:1), and expanded Landscape (16:9)
UX: In Vertical layout, the image occupies up to 85% of the row with near-fit expansion (max-width up to 520px, max-height 180px), leaving a compact neat space for the caption and radio button
UX: In Horizontal layout, cards with landscape, banner, or fit shapes automatically expand up to 320px for clear visibility
New: Registration Form Image Option field now supports rectangular image shapes — Landscape (16:9), Wide (4:3), Portrait (3:4), Square (1:1) — configurable per field in the form builder
New: Registration Form Image Option field now supports Vertical list layout (stacked rows with image left, label right) in addition to the default Horizontal card grid
Fix: Critical api.php parse error (missing closing brace) that caused HTTP 500 on all API requests including media library and uploads on shared hosting (InfinityFree / Apache / PHP)
Fix: Media Library now fully loads and displays files on hosted PHP environments (was broken from v2.9.1)
Fix: File uploads now succeed on shared hosting — removed custom X-Admin-Token header from upload fetch to prevent CORS OPTIONS preflight blocks
Fix: PHP 8.4 compatibility in list_assets — safe stat() access with @stat() and fallback filesize()/filemtime() to prevent fatal TypeErrors
Fix: Directory permissions set to 0777 for assets/uploads, data, and data/revisions ensuring PHP move_uploaded_file succeeds on shared hosts
Fix: Restored data/store_feed.json and data/templates.json that were wiped by Developer Hub push bug
New: Add-On Studio wizard fully mobile-friendly — prop rows reflow to 2-column card layout, tab bar scrolls horizontally, footer buttons stack vertically
